about_short_description.short_description: Jemi helps people build beautiful websites and stores.

product.name: Jemi Website and Store Builder
product.description: A drag-and-drop website and e-commerce store builder that requires no coding or design skills, enabling users to create branded websites quickly.

product.name: E-commerce Features
product.description: Tools integrated into Jemi for selling physical merchandise, digital downloads, and subscription services with payment processing via Stripe and PayPal.

product.name: Template Library
product.description: A collection of customizable website and online store templates with various layouts, colors, and fonts to suit different business and personal needs.

product.name: SEO and Marketing Tools
product.description: Built-in search engine optimization features and marketing integrations to improve website visibility and promote business growth.

product.name: Custom Code Embedding
product.description: Allows users on Pro or Business plans to embed custom HTML, JavaScript, and iFrames into their websites for advanced customization.
